summary: Q3 opened with a semiconductor-led unwind (SOXX -6.41%, MU -10.57%) as Q2's biggest winners were sold. Capital rotated into software (IGV +3.02%), broker-dealers, healthcare and internet; META +8.81% on a cloud-business launch. Hawkish Warsh ('prices are too high') lifted the 10y to 4.46%; oil fell as Hormuz eased. SPX slipped to Neutral Bull but breadth stayed positive — rotation, not panic.
